underlines.text: When I said that he improved on acquaintance

reference.text: “Yes, very different; but I think Mr. Darcy improves on acquaintance.”

underlines.text: Wickham’s alarm now appeared in a heightened complexion

reference.text: He looked surprised, displeased, alarmed; but, with a moment’s recollection, and a returning smile, replied, that he had formerly seen him often; and, after observing that he was a very gentlemanlike man, asked her how she had liked him.
